result.summary: The page is largely well-rendered, but there is one clear visual defect: the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' has overlapping text where the delivery time and delivery fee are drawn on top of each other.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the subtitle row for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows '25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' rendered on top of each other (appearing as garbled '25–3€0mdelivery'), making the delivery time and fee unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the metadata items in a horizontal flex row with proper spacing/separators (e.g., '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') instead of absolutely positioning them at the same origin; ensure each text node has its own inline box.
